§ 01 · The Program

A complete
portfolio.

From foundational B1 transportation vocabulary to advanced C1 logistics strategy and analytics discourse, every module is anchored in real-world transportation scenarios — from fleet management to route optimization, from public transit to autonomous mobility. Built for use inside logistics companies, transit authorities, fleet operators, and mobility technology firms.

01

Industry-anchored

AI-powered route optimization, autonomous vehicle systems, and predictive maintenance run throughout the program — reflecting today's transportation industry.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Transportation Business English Expert

Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international transportation professionals. Vector reflects his vision: language learning as operational capability — a multiplier of careers, networks, and influence.

Designed for the logistics executives, fleet managers, and mobility leaders shaping global transportation — Vector is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to move the world forward in one of the fastest-evolving industries on the planet.
